main.description: One manager's unpublished changes to one press kit, in their repo in the project's backstage (computer.localnetwork.space.backstage). The record key is the press kit's: an existing one's, or for a new press kit, the key it will be published under, so a manager has at most one draft per press kit. Photos it adds are blobs in the manager's repo until publishing copies them to the Local Network root account's.

base.description: The published press kit (a computer.localnetwork.epk record) at the version this draft started from. Absent for a press kit that isn't published yet.

changes.description: The fields this draft changes, with their new values. A field left out is unchanged; an empty string, list or object clears it.

previous.description: What each changed field held in the published press kit when the draft changed it; a changed field missing here was empty. Publishing compares these with the current values to find fields someone else published since. Absent for a press kit that isn't published yet.

fields.description: Some fields of a press kit: the public record's at the top level, the private part's under content.

contentFields.description: Some fields of a press kit's computer.localnetwork.epk.content record.
